notes: Building and Engineering News, vol. 30 part 1 (Internet Archive buildingengineer3030cont), the 26 weekly issues from 4 January to 28 June 1930. Same method as the earlier volumes: every numbered entry under Building Permit Applications and Building Contracts was taken from the djvu.xml OCR, East Bay headings set aside, and each San Francisco lot built from the block corner on the DPW street centrelines and compared with the sf-parcels shapes; a placement was accepted where the lot starts within two feet of a lot line of today (or the record names an unambiguous corner) and the roll dates the building 1929-1932, and alterations were matched by printed street number in sf-eas-addresses where the roll dates the building before 1930. Every published row was read against the page image, location first; 97 of the 121 rows read needed a name, a cost or the wording corrected, and a cost or name that could not be read on the image was left out. Where a permit and its contract appear in the same issue the page carries one entry and the contract finding is held. Descriptions of rows marked confidence low were built from the OCR and have not been read against the image. Owners are private individuals and are cut everywhere (raw.note); a firm or institution named as owner is kept, and where the contractor or architect named is the owner or shares the owner's surname that name is cut too. Sub-trade contracts are timeline entries and set no builder credit. Completion notices, liens, sub-contracts printed 'on above' and the news columns were not taken. Issue dates come from the running heads (redate.py) and agree with the cover line of each of the 26 issues.

coverage.remaining: Vols. 26 to 29 and vol. 30 part 1 read (January 1926 to June 1930); the other 25 half-year volumes (1915 to January 1932) are unread, vol. 30 part 2 (July-December 1930) next. In this volume: 184 rows placed on a parcel whose roll year fits, all single houses with no architect named and no page, are logged and held until another fact gives the parcel a page (extra.placed_apn; they still need the image check). 264 rows have a nearest parcel that was not accepted (the lot starts off today's lot lines, or the roll dates the building outside the window). 411 rows were not placed: 200 location lines not parsed (tract lots, garbled headings), 89 street pairs that do not cross under the names read (OCR spellings, renamed streets) and 122 printed street numbers with no EAS row today.
coverage.note: 1,776 numbered entries read, 980 San Francisco rows, 569 placed on a parcel, 121 picked and read against the page image, 112 published on 104 pages (43 seeded), 9 held back at the image check (four same-issue contracts merged into the permit entry, five uses or dates that contradict the roll).
